title: Helpers--Carpenters
description: Help carpenters by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include using, supplying, or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Erecting temporary structures requires physical assembly

tasks.text: Clean work areas, machines, or equipment, to maintain a clean and safe job site.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Equipment and facility cleaning is hands-on

tasks.text: Align, straighten, plumb, or square forms for installation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual placement and alignment of forms on site

tasks.text: Select tools, equipment, or materials from storage and transport items to work site.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Construction material selection needs code and site judgment

dwas.name: Move construction or extraction materials to locations where they are needed.

tasks.text: Fasten timbers or lumber with glue, screws, pegs, or nails and install hardware.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Wood structural installation is manual carpentry

tasks.text: Position and hold timbers, lumber, or paneling in place for fastening or cutting.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Positioning structural components is physical labor

tasks.text: Cut timbers, lumber, or paneling to specified dimensions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Wood cutting requires manual tool operation

tasks.text: Hold plumb bobs, sighting rods, or other equipment to aid in establishing reference points and lines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking reference points is hands-on site work

dwas.name: Mark reference points on construction materials.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Welding is skilled hands-on metalwork

tasks.text: Drill holes in timbers or lumber.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling construction materials is hands-on tool work

tasks.text: Glue and clamp edges or joints of assembled parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on adhesive application in unstructured construction settings

tasks.text: Install handrails under the direction of a carpenter.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Installing fixtures requires manual dexterity

tasks.text: Construct forms and assist in raising them to the required elevation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical assisting of skilled trades on site

dwas.name: Assist skilled construction or extraction personnel.

tasks.text: Secure stakes to grids for constructions of footings, nail scabs to footing forms, and vibrate and float concrete.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating compaction equipment by hand on site

dwas.name: Compact materials to create level bases.

tasks.text: Perform tie spacing layout and measure, mark, drill or cut.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical measurement for assembly fitting

dwas.name: Measure materials or objects for installation or assembly.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Mark reference points on construction materials.

tasks.text: Smooth or sand surfaces to remove ridges, tool marks, glue, or caulking.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Abrasive hand work on physical surfaces

dwas.name: Smooth surfaces with abrasive materials or tools.

tasks.text: Cover surfaces with laminated plastic covering material.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual application of protective coverings

dwas.name: Apply protective coverings to objects or surfaces near work areas.

tasks.text: Cut and install insulating or sound-absorbing material.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hand cutting of flexible flooring materials

dwas.name: Install insulation in equipment or structures.
Cut carpet, vinyl or other flexible materials.

tasks.text: Cut tile or linoleum to fit and spread adhesives on flooring for installation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on adhesive application in unstructured construction settings

dwas.name: Cut carpet, vinyl or other flexible materials.
